title: Referral links in a small share of text responses
summary:
Referral links were added to a small share of Markdown responses, alongside visit tracking and changes to chat response metadata.

Referral-link processing was added for roughly 1% of eligible Markdown text responses. It can turn up to three existing product or concept mentions into links; plain-text responses stay unchanged, and processing errors leave the original content intact.

A /referral route was added to record the topic attached to a visit, then redirect visitors to the pollinations.ai homepage after three seconds.

OpenAI-format responses now get a newly generated ID and creation timestamp rather than preserving provider metadata. The response helper also stopped filling in missing choice indexes and adding its previous cache header.
